verdict: Organic presence is holding but paid channels are fully dark across all locations.
narrative: Across all three locations this period, paid advertising on Meta and Google carried zero spend and produced zero leads — your inbound activity is coming entirely from Google Business Profile presence. Combined, your locations generated 362 GBP actions in the last 28 days (calls, direction requests, and website clicks), which confirms real search demand for your business. However, GBP engagement dropped sharply in the most recent week at Forte Metals (–91%) and Advance Grinding (–74%), and O'Hare Precision saw a more moderate decline (–13%), signaling a visibility issue that needs attention now. Paid campaigns are being reactivated to restore a reliable lead pipeline and reduce dependence on organic-only traffic.
